details: Completed Mega Menu UX Gap Analysis (Stream 4). Produced 4-part implementation roadmap document: Part A (7 sections mapping MegaMenu.tsx lines to changes: Column interface, buildColumns(), rendering, nav bar, hover/click, mobile, footer), Part B (4-phase plan: Foundation 2-3d, Desktop 3-5d, Mobile 4-6d, Polish 2-3d = 11-17d total), Part C1 (mobile pattern: hybrid accordion+drill-down, full-screen overlay, stack state, animations), Part C2 (lazy loading, search, touch targets, accessibility, integration). 85 spec citations across all sources.
